A.notes: Site A presents a clean and functional layout but relies on a somewhat generic, card-heavy structure. The CSS illustrations and counter animations are implemented well but don't feel deeply integrated into a larger conceptual narrative. It also suffers from WCAG color contrast violations, likely in the secondary text.

B.notes: Site B achieves a sophisticated editorial feel with exceptional bilingual typography and a highly appropriate color palette. The layout features elegant touches, such as the sticky donation form that remains accessible while users review gift tiers, and subtle parallax motion in the hero illustration. It passes all accessibility checks flawlessly.

raw.why: Site B offers a much stronger editorial design with superior bilingual typography, clever interaction patterns like the sticky donation form, and perfect accessibility.
